capabilities: Build graph filters as structured include/exclude lines
Autocomplete tag, path, and file values per clause
Write the generated filter string into the native graph filter input
extras: Desktop-only because it queries the graph view's internal DOM; uses non-public APIs, so an Obsidian update could break it. Not reverse-parseable: the panel always starts empty rather than reading back a manually typed filter.
intentEvidence: It does not replace the native filter — it generates the filter string and writes it into the existing input.
motivation: The README's 'Why' section states the native filter's single text input makes long expressions hard to read and edit and its syntax is friction.
problem: The native graph filter is a single text input whose syntax (path:, tag:, -tag:) is hard to remember and long expressions are hard to read and edit.
summary: Structured filter panel for Obsidian's graph view that builds include/exclude filter lines with type selection and autocomplete.
